$comment: R77 (D212): how a concentration spell is used again without a slot while it lasts. A concentration spell that deals damage repeats its first effect by default: single-target spells with the economy they were cast with, area spells as a free roll when a creature enters or starts its turn there (economy none). This file lists only the spells that differ from that default. false: the spell has no repeat. A module may put the same object under its spell-mechanic config as "sustain".
